articleTitle: Strategies for Complexity Management Coping with Cost Estimation. The Case of Customized Furniture Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Industrial Technology and Management (ICITM)
abstract: The task of cost and price estimation is primarily grounded upon the company's capacity to recognize complexity, which is rapidly growing in the modern manufacturing sector. A great deal of today's industries face a problem of growing complexity, which affects all vital functions of the organization and puts up a serious challenge in terms of company's competitiveness. The goal of the present research is to find out how furniture companies working with customization manufacturing identify complexity in their performance and what strategies they use to deal with the complexity of pricing in cases of new orders.

articleTitle: Failure Modes and Effects Analysis: An Integrated Approach for Optimizing Maintainability and Redesign for the Concrete Pump
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Industrial Technology and Management (ICITM)
abstract: This is study purpose to examine the Failure Mode and Affected Analyses (FMEA) in the Synaxis Ready Mix for Concrete Solutions in Dubai. Four factories mixers were examined. The measurement used to obtain the objectives of this study include; analyzing the failure curve and identifying its reasons, reliability, maintainability, and the repair and replacement policy. In addition, this study suggests adopting optimal maintenance strategies such as; Condition-Based Maintenance (CBM) <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sup>Condition-Based Maintenance (CBM) is a maintenance program that recommends maintenance decision based on the information collected through condition monitoring (Jardine et al., 2006). and Reliability Centered-Maintenance (RCM) 2 according to the characteristics each part that consisting of a concrete mixer to avoid sudden breakdown of this equipment during providing services based on analyzing the reasons for the failure. Where CBM strategy is appropriate for application of the “critical parts” in this machine, e.g. Inclined Belt driven and Motor Belt. RCM strategy can also be applied to the critical part, e.g. Extractor, as well as, it's could be applied for each of the “important parts” such as; Coupling Hose, Clamp 3pcs Change, Air Compressor Pulley, and Water Pipe Leaking. In this study, the final results showed the effective contribution that the concrete mixer company will be obtained based on its implementation of this proposed RCM and CBM strategies including; (1) Decreasing the negative influence of sudden breakdowns and therefore improve the system overall, (2) Increasing the employee safety and (3) Improving the quality of outcomes by reducing the raw materials waste.

articleTitle: Entrepreneurial Orientation for Project Sustainability and Business Success
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Industrial Technology and Management (ICITM)
abstract: Entrepreneurial Orientation (EO) pertains to the possession of organizational-level entrepreneurship, which can stimulate the success of entrepreneurial firms. This study is aimed at exploring how EO influences the project sustainability and business success of large Thai firms in the property industry. A quantitative study is undertaken to study these relationships, with statistical analysis carried out through multiple regression. Questionnaires were devised to collect data from project management practitioners through purposive sampling, with 367 completed valid responses being returned for the analysis. The results show that EO has a significant positive effect on project sustainability. The findings also indicate that EO is the critical factor affecting the business success or failure of large Thai property firms. Thus, the study contributes to the literature by uncovering the importance of EO for project management practitioners in enhancing project sustainability and business success in this industry.

articleTitle: Identifying Participants' Characteristics Influencing Participant Estimation in Knowledge-Intensive Crowdsourcing
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Industrial Technology and Management (ICITM)
abstract: In knowledge-intensive crowdsourcing, estimating proper participants is an important way of ensuring tasks' outcomes. Multiple participants' characteristics have influence on participant estimation and should be considered comprehensively. Nevertheless, to the best of our knowledge, few studies particularly focused on investigating and proposing a common list of participants' characteristics. So this paper aims to investigate and identify a list of participants' characteristics that influence participant estimation in knowledge-intensive crowdsourcing. This study initially searches, filters, and analyses literatures related to the topic of this study, and subsequently extracts participants' characteristics. Furthermore, seven crowdsourcing marketplaces which are used widely to crowdsource knowledge-intensive tasks are investigated to acquire participants' characteristics presented in practical crowdsourcing systems. Combining those characteristics of participants obtained from the two aspects, the paper finally highlights five major participants' characteristics and their sub-characteristics.

articleTitle: Open Innovation in the Automotive Industry
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Industrial Technology and Management (ICITM)
abstract: The Automotive Industry has traditionally invested on its own R&D as a unique Innovation' driver. The increasing global connectivity requirements and production costs pressure in the late twentieth and early 21st centuries have brought their share of challenges and compelled the Automotive Industry to look outside its own boundaries to deal with complex demands and new customer's profile. This paper is an exploratory review that attempts to provide a qualitative answer to the following question: → How does Open Innovation (OI) manifest itself in the Automotive Industry? Despite the abundant literature on the concept of OI (strategies, process models, practices, business models, digital platforms, different applications ... etc.), the study of OI in the automotive context remains poorly studied. Thus, Part I of this paper explores OI' ecosystems and interactions between heterogeneous actors in the Innovation process, the second part sets out the predominant OI process model (Inbound/Outbound/Coupled), and the third part looks at the crucial issue of OI practices and their effectiveness. Lastly, we conclude with a consideration of how would be the future of the Automotive Innovation in an increasingly globalized and connected world.

articleTitle: Hot Spot Visualization Analysis of Energy Storage Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Industrial Technology and Management (ICITM)
abstract: This study visualize the literature in the field of energy storage technology in the core database of Web of Science from 2003 to 2017. And also reviews the structure and content of the research network of foreign energy storage technologies, using cluster analysis of co-citation of quotations and co-occurrence analysis of Keywords and authors of literature. This reveals the key literature, hot topics and research cooperation in the field of energy storage. It is hoped that the research results of the article can provide valuable reference and reference for research and development in the field of energy storage technology. Research findings: The hotspot of energy storage technology has gradually turned from early lithium-ion batteries, traditional capacitors and fuel cells to supercapacitors, asymmetric capacitors and phase change energy storage. The research on energy storage materials has also gradually shifted from the initial material selection and performance exploration to the design of composite nanomaterials and material structures.
